messages.content: My daughters 6th birthday was recently, unfortunately her mothers side of the family didn't show up, even though they all rsvp'd
Too bad for them! My sons 6th birthday was just last week, and we had a fun party. There so much easier to please when their little lol.
Hah yea, she was sad at first but there was plenty of presents and people who love her around to distract her. They grow up fast.
They do. I can't believe how fast the time goes.

Recently I bought a keyboard that I was looking forward to buying for a long time. My old one kept double-tapping on certain letters. I was so happy when it arrived, I took it out of the box and I have had so much fun using it since then.
That is great. Did you buy anything else?
I got an extra day off this week that I wasn't expecting!
I bet You're so happy! I would be!
I really am. I love days off, but I suppose everyone does too lol
Who doesn't :) what are you planning to do?
I saw a strange figure in the woods whilst camping last weekend.
That must have frightened you. Was it the beef jerky sasquatch?
I watched a movie the other night that really got me in my feelings.
Oh wow, what ovie was it and how did it make you feel?
Yesterday I took a test for a promotion at work. I felt pretty good about it.
Did you pass?
I haven't gotten the results yet. I studied for weeks and knew the material We'll, so it was easy.
I have a feeling you got it.
I just found out that my girlfriend has been cheating on me. God this is the worst week of my life.
I feel really sorry for you. Will you be okay?
I don't know, its weird just sitting at home and knowing she isn't here.
I hope everything works out for you.
My wife is having a hard time after finding out we can no longer have children. I am doing my best to support her and care for her but it is very hard when nothing seems to work.
Oh That's heartbreaking, do you guys already have children?
When I was in elementary school I was envious of the kids who were popular!
Yeah as a child it's hard to see other kids with a bunch of friends when you don't have that many.
Recently there have been a few break ins.
Oh no! Did you property get broken into? Or your neighbor's property?
I will be getting paid today!
Nice! That's an odd day to be paid, but good for you!
I had wanted to wear a pair of earrings that my grandmother gave me to her funeral.
Why didn't you wore them?
I have a birthday coming up. I really hop I get the gift I am asking for.
Oh, Happy early Birthday! What is it that you are hoping for?
Thank you, I am hoping for a new camera. It is about time to upgrade.
Nice! I hope you get it! Cameras are such a wonderful tool to have these days and there are so many cool options to choose from.
I put in a job application for a new job. I am fairly certain that my credentials are enough to get me the job.
That's awesome! Have you been scheduled for an interview yet?
I was, I go in next Tuesday. I am pretty excited for them to give me the job.
I would be too! I hope everything goes We'll with it!

One morning my mother came to my house to pick my daughter up for school and told me she saw my daughter's cat on the road and he had been hit. I had to tell my daughter about the loss of her beloved pet.
Oh no that is terrible! How did your daughter take it?
I let my coworker handle my project when I was on sick leave.
That was nice of them to chip in. It must have felt good that you had someone to help.
I agree, I felt really trusting of him and he did really We'll.
That's wonderful. It makes all the difference to have people you can trust, especially when you are not feeling We'll.
I spent hours studying for a final exam.
How did they go? Did you pass?
I asked my friend to get some stuff for a party, I knew I could count on him though.
That's good to have friends you can count on! What kind of party are you having?
It was a birthday party.
Nice! Happy belated birthday :) I hope you had a wonderful time with your friends
I was sad before I met my girlfriend, I did nothing interesting
Why not? You only live once get out. Make the most out of every day!
That is true, I was just depressed
Sorry to hear that. How did you meet your lady friend?
I wish I was taller.
My husband has that issue. Are you shorter than average?
I have a meeting with my boss in a few hours...
The way you wrote that makes it seem like You're anticipating something bad... Do you mind if I ask what You're expecting to happen?
I had 2 job interviews yesterday and my nerves are on edge today..
How do you think they went?
I think they went We'll. I'm keeping my fingers crossed.
I hope so too! Good luck. :D
I have to go to a team meeting in the morning. I am unsure what to expect
Oh, Do you think you did something wrong?
No, it just came out of the blue, I never know what to expect really
That's terrible I wouldn't like for that to happen to me.
Looking to get this new job in my area.
Great, I hope you get it.
Me too, been researching everything I can about them so I am ready for it.
What type of job is it?
Ever go back and watch old movies?
I sure do! What are some of your favorites?
I was watching old disney movies, made me nostalgic.
Oh yeah those will do that. I still have like 40 of them on VCR or video cassette, whatever those things were called. I doubt I would be able to find one these days that would actually play them@
A few months ago I found some old family pictures. It made me miss old times
Were they from when you were a kid?
They were. It made me miss all my cousins and Aunts and Uncles who've passed.
I know what you mean. I sure miss my departed loved ones.
A tree fell on my house, shattering my vinyl fence as my kids and I were walking passed it through the garage.
Woah I hope no one was hurt
My son is teething really bad and he is so inconsolable that breaks my heart. I can't wait till these molars cut thru
I remember my kids going through that. Do you have teething rings for him?
I do but he doesn't like them. He can barely eat his mouth hurts so bad
Poor boy. I hope he gets through it soon.
I really like to learn and I'm so ready to go back to school. I can't wait for classes to start!
Congratulations! What are you studying?
I'm so grateful I have a working car to get around and run errands now!
That's wonderful! I know how important that can be! Our family of 4 only has one car so you need it to work! What happened to yours?
I used to have my dog in his crate when I left for work. Lately I have been letting him out more and more in the house when I've been gone.
That's good. How is it going?
I have hope that this weekend will be fun. I am off and hope to do something fun
Sounds fun! Where ya headed to?
When my dad told me he was getting married, I was over the moon
Were you happy for him? Or did you get sad because you didn't want that to happen?
I was delighted for him, his new wife is so great for him, and she's always been really cool to me
That's great, I'm glad she's nice to you.
I'm having a party this weekend and I already got my grocery shopping done for it! I refuse to be last minute like last time.
I have a friend who plans ahead like that. I'm a last minute gal. I think you will be less stressed by planning ahead.
I was lonely before I met my girlfriend and friends
When did you meet them?
In high school and college!
Nice. How long have you all been together?
I was feeling very hungry earlier today.
Did you eat something?
Yes and now I also have much food in front of me that is extra. I don't want any of it right now.
Toss it in the fridge or freezer. That's what I always do. Food for a rainy day :D
I'm looking forward to going to Colorado for my new sister-in-law's wedding reception! ^_^
That's awesome! I've never been to Colorado but I hear great things! Haha
I myself haven't been there in 11 years! I'm looking forward to seeing it again.
11 years is a long time, I hope you have a great time!
A while back I moved from Chicago to Dallas, I was pretty sad to leave. It was my hometown!
Big change! Both big cities though right? I've always wanted to see that shiny bean thing in chicago.
Yes both are big cities! However Chicago feels less crowded honestly, the metroplex there is more spread out.
I hope you continue to adjust to your new surroundings, maybe you will end up loving Dallas, who knows!
I had a argument with my manager. I think that I will be let go soon,
What did you argue about?
We couldn't agree on how to conduct the project. It is not the first time. I need to start looking for another job before it is too late.
That is smart, sorry that is happening to you!
I'm not sure if I want to go tomorrow
Where? Why are you feeling uncertain?
We're supposed to be roller coaster riding tomorrow :/
I can understand the nerves, but it will be fun!
I work from home
Nice, that's very convenient, do you enjoy it?
I had a great time this weekend.
Oh yeah? Nice to hear. What exactly did you do?
We took a trip to the mountains to hike. So nice to be away from the city outside in nature.
That's awesome, I'm from Kansas and first went to Colorado just a couple years ago. It was beautiful!
That sounds fun. I haven't been to Colorado yet. I'd like to go.
I agree though, always a good time to get away and explore some nature life.

The mosquitos where I live seemed to be getting really bad! When sitting by the fire at night we get so eaten up even with bug spray and candles! So for this last time we did a fire I bought these two blue lantern things that attract the mosquitoes and zap them to death! Let me tell you, those mosquitoes didn't stand a chance, and no bug spray needed!
Those sound super effective. I wish I had some of them here, I have never seen mosquitoes as bad as they are this year.
Yes! You can order them online from large retailers! It is a must have if you spend a good amount of time outdoors in mosquito prone areas!
I will have to look into those, they sound like a really good investment.
Looking forward to getting my cats a new cat tree tomorrow! It is a warehouse deal so I am hoping it is in good shape!
I hope the cat likes it
I am so mad that my brother stole 100 bucks from me,
Really? Have you spoken to him about it?
Yes but he denies doing it. But I saw him take it.
What about your parents? Can they help?
My sister threw a party for me a few months ago.
That's nice of her. What was the occasion?
I was so sad growing up. I always wanted a horse and my parents never got me one.
That's too bad, did you ever get to ride horses at all?
I picked up this aardvark on the black market. Named him Arthur. He pooped all over my carpet yesterday.
What is a aardvark?
I was able to pull up on the internet pictures from where I lived as a kid. I felt like I was right back there.
Very nice. I bet you were full of joy to see them.
I am so ready to go to Japan.
Wow! When do you go?
I leave in November.
Not too long to wait then. Are you going to Tokyo?
I thought we we're going to be able to close on a new house recently but it didn't work out as planned.
Just remember things happen for a reason. When one door closes another one opens.
Thanks. I'm hoping something else will come along soon.
Just stay positive and always be thankful.
The walk I was on today got a little dangerous at one point.
Oh, really? What happened to you?
I am a unhappy that there is nothing I could do to help
Oh no! What had happened to you?
I bought a lemon cake two days ago
Oh, that sounds tasty have you eaten it yet?
I have a deadline at work coming up.
For what kind of project?
It is top-secret. But every time I try and get serious work done, my co-workers won't leave me alone.
Did you tell them to leave you alone?
I was trying to study for a final but my neighbors were being really loud, and I had a hard time focusing
Did you go over and ask them to turn down the volume?
No, I'm shy and try to avoid confrontation as much as possible
We'll, I hope you have some really good earphones - or that they quiet down - it's a big egotistical to think that no one around you cares when you are that loud.
I am looking forward to the winter.
Me too, I'm excited for fall, I like to layer my clothes
I was riding my bike the other day, and passed all these flies hovering over a mutilated armidillo.
Sounds super gross! I bet you were a mess.
Yeah it was pretty nasty. Problem was I didn't even recognize what it was until I was right on top of it!
That's how it usually is then boom fly guts all over your helmet and clothes.
My sister threw a party for me a few months ago.
That's nice of her. What was the occasion?
My bridal shower. I thought I was just going over to have dinner there.
Ha that's nice of her! We'll if you haven't had your wedding yet, I hope it turns out super nice!
I have SO much to get done around here before summer ends, I am feeling positive about getting it done even through pain.
We'll atleast when you finish you can pop a beer and enjoy your hard work
I ordered a surface pro yesterday! Its gonna be so cool to play around with when it arrives
That's cool. I've always been a Mac kind of girl, but I would look into a Surface is I was in the market for a new computer.

I only ever wanted one cause they can do the same stuff a regular computer can but also touch screen so you can draw on it, I always got discouraged drawing on paper cause I'd waste so much of it, and then just stop
I get that. I got a bamboo tablet a few years ago, but I feel like working directly on the screen would be even better.
When I was walking home last night I was robbed . Was terrrible
Oh god! That must have been so scary
I just froze and did what they wanted. They pullled a gun and a knife. I gave them my money in my pocket and they left. It was 12 dollars
Oh god! Just hand them what they want, it's not worth your life
My friend just died last week. I went over to her house to help sort her stuff.
That is terrible, are you okay?
Yeah. It was actually nice to look through all her old photo albums from our fun times together.
I feel super bad about that, I wish the best for you.
I am shocked my brother is getting married.
Really - do you know the bride?
My kid lied to me yesterday.
I've had that happen before. Its like they are trying to become professionals at it. Was it a whopper?
Not really, they are young, but they were trying to get a sibling in trouble instead of themselves. I wasn't expecting it at such a young age...Only 3.

I think they would lie sooner if they could. My kid told me flat out that her brother did something when it was impossible that he could've so I knew instantly. Its humorous while They're young watching them get into such a deep hole.
I went to the beach other day.. Such an awesome feeling standing there
Yeah, I love going to the beach as We'll! You must have felt so happy there in that moment!
I most certainly did.. There is something about looking at the calm and glory of the ocean.
I feel happy and content just sitting here listening to you describe the experience.
Once I was in a drive-by shooting
Oh dang that sounds really scary. I'm assuming that since You're still here that you are okay?
Today I woke up, and I realised that I am more than content with my life, it made me happy and peaceful
That would be a great feeling. Did something happen to make you feel more content?
Yes, I just realised I have everything I ever wanted in my life
That's so awesome! Congrats! I am hoping to get there soon. I have a lot to be thankful for but I know I need to work on just a little bit before I am fully content.
I am really nervous. I have to go tomorrow to get my tooth pulled and I am scared to death. I hate the dentist!
Oh no! I hate the dentist too! I haven't been in forever. I'm sorry. You will be okay though! Hoping it all goes We'll. Is it hurting you?
Not really, but I want to have it done before something bad like that happens.
That makes total sense! Good job for thinking ahead like that!
My dog died this week. I'm really upset about it.
I am so sorry about that. How are you holding up?
I was crushed when I wasn't able to go to vegas as planned
What got in the way of your plans?
Work!
That's such a shame, I'm sorry to hear that.
I got an extra day off this week that I wasn't expecting!
I bet You're so happy! I would be!
I have this boyfriend, he's so nice, I promised not to cheat on him
That's awesome, I hope he returns the favor as We'll.
Someone helped me move.
Were they a close friend? And did you pay them with pizza?
Yes, and I paid them with beer. I was thankful because I had a toe injury.
I had a shoulder injury when I last moved, except I had to pay movers and pretend they were my friends for a day.
The past few months have been going quite We'll, I'm happy with how things have gone
Good to hear that, what is interesting
Things have just been going how I planned and I'm pretty stress free so its been nice for once
That's great. I hope they do on my side too
I just celebrated my birthday and it was so much better than usual.
That's great. What made it so special this year?
I usually don't do much to celebrate but this year a friend of mine got all my other friends together to throw a party for me without me knowing. It was a great time.
Sounds like fun! I'm glad you had a happy birthday.
My daughter got into an Ivy league school after high school. I am so happy for her!
You must be so happy and proud! Is she going to have to move far away to go?
They other day was my son's first day of school, and when I dropped him off it brought back so much memories.
That's great. Is that your only son?
Yes, he's my only son. I can't wait until he get's his first girlfriend like I did in middle school. Those were the days.
I'm sure the memories will be great
I know I will pass my English class.
Cool. What makes you so confident
I forgot to put gas in my car and I ran out of gas on the side of the road!
Oh my! You must have been pretty embarrassed. Did someone bring you gas?
Thanksgiving is almost here.
I know I am really exited, what do you have planned?
I'm having to cancel my Labor Day plans since I have to work. My boss is taking a trip and we both can't be gone from work. I'm disappointed.
That stinks! What were your plans?
I was going to Georgia to watch my cousin's son play in his first college football game. It was going to be a nice family reunion type trip.
I'm so sorry you had to change your plans! Perhaps you can schedule some time after Labor Day to come and see him play?
When I go to church, I know that the lord is taking care of me.
That must be a good feeling.
It is, the bond between us is unbreakable.
I use to go to church when I was little.
I think I will get my debt paid off sooner than I originally planned!
That's so awesome! What a huge relief that must be.
It's a huge relief but I need to make sure everything goes as planned or it won't happen.
Keep focused! You can do it! Being debt free is an amazing feeling!
I loved taking care of my sisters pet
What pet does she have?
I had a couple rabbits once, interesting pets to take care of.
Do you still have them?
No, this was as a kid. The dog essentially killed one. Then the other one became more grumpy.
Do you own any other pets now?
My dog sheds so much I have to vacuum my room practically every 4 days if I don't want little tufts of fur everywhere.
I love puppies! But they definitely are a lot of work in terms of their hair.
You're right. I'm just so irritated, even if it isn't his fault and I love the big goof.
I understand. Our puppy sheds a ton too and he isn't even that hairy of a dog
I was recently looking through an old photo album and it made me feel strange.
What made you feel strange?
I am so proud of my wife, she was very nervous today but still went to her interview.
Oh wow! That's great. Did she say how it went?
I just celebrated my birthday and it was so much better than usual.
That's great. What made it so special this year?
I have SO much to get done around here before summer ends, I am feeling positive about getting it done even through pain.
We'll atleast when you finish you can pop a beer and enjoy your hard work
Not a drinker ;) lol. But I will feel accomplished. I would pop a piece of sugar really lol
Hahaha yeah or go to a nice restaurant to feel relaxed after all that hard work
I don't know if you have kids, but my sister in law is a person that should have never had them.
I do. Why do you say that about her?
She refuses to take care of them, letting my mother in law basically raise them, while she goes out and spends every dime she makes on herself.
That's terrible. Her kids are going to resent her.
Have you been to a circus?
I have. It was a long time ago. I had a lot of fun watching it with my daughter but I always feel sad for the animals, until I found out that the circus I went to helps injured animals have a home.
Does it make you happy to see others you haven't seen in a while
Sometimes depending on who they are.
I recently seen my Mum after not seeing her for 6 months . I was so happy to see her .
That's so nice. I'm happy for you.
Thank you
Are you gonna see each other again soon?
I saw a movie last night that made me think of old times. When I was a kid
What was the name of the movie?
When I was pregnant, I felt I'll until it was over. The doctors were worried that something was wrong with the baby.
Oh no! I'm not sure how all that works, but I thought that was fairly normal for a pregnat woman

Usually the sickness stops within the first few months, so the fact that I fell I'll so much was worrisome. Despite it all, I had a healthy, bouncing baby boy. I never have felt more grateful in my life.
We'll I'm glad for you! And for him! A new life is exciting
I'm giving birth on wednesday.... I can't wait!
Wow, congratulations! Are you nervous?
My girlfriend said she was going to catch up with her ex boyfriend over coffee. I am sure that nothing shady will go on between them.
Surely not, do you trust her.
I am very sad these days
I am so sorry to hear that. Is it related to your work?
My favorite game has an expansion on Monday, I can't wait.
Nice! What game?
World of Warcraft, It's been my favorite for years.
Oh cool, I've heard of it but never played, I'm not too good with games.
I trust my wife with my life
That's a good bond how long have you been together?
I had a job interview last week, and I felt like I knew I was going to get the job after I left
That sounds great, I hope you get it!
Thanks! Yeah, I felt so prepared and wasn't really nervous at all!
I'm always nervous at job interviews!

messages.content: I'm handling six deadlines at once and everything feels urgent.
When everything is urgent, nothing feels manageable. Which of those six would actually hurt most if it slipped?
My daughter has a cold today, so I'm taking care of her.
I'm sorry to hear that? Is it a bad cold?
Someone took my phone when I was at work.
From your house? Do you have any idea who did it?
I have a meeting with my boss in a few hours...
The way you wrote that makes it seem like You're anticipating something bad... Do you mind if I ask what You're expecting to happen?
See, that's the thing... I have no idea what to expect. That's why I'm so nervous about it.

Interesting... We'll then at least that leaves the possibility for something good instead. If You're not sure what it could be, then at least it's not some obvious mistake or negligence on your part. I hope for the best for you
My friend randomly gave me a gift out of nowhere!
That's great, what did he give you?
My husband is so lucky I cheat on him like he did.
Why do you cheat on him?
I could have. But I didn't. He cheated on me actually.
Oh I see, why are you still with him then?
I'm excited to start a new project at work
Cool. Are you in charge?
I was missing my family back home.
How often do you visit them?
We'll they actually came to my home from 300 miles away and were awaiting me when I came home one night, It was so cool!
That is really nice of them seems you have a lovely family, when was the last time you saw them?
I fell of my motorcycle in front of a crowd.
Oh, no! That's terrible! Were you okay?
Yea, I was turning and the bike tipped over, lucky I wasn't going fast.
I'm so glad you were okay!

My significant other woke up last night with... A roach inside of her ear! She was complaining about pain in her ear, and a head ache that was incredibly severe. So, we took her to the doctor and he saw it with a light... And put water in her ear to get it out. Disgusting!
Oh gross! I've heard of flies or ants being in an ear, but a roach? That gives me chills because I hate roaches sooooo much. Now I might have nightmares tonight!

I'm sorry! I didn't mean for that. Yeah, some smaller ones--heck, even bigger ones, can get up there. And then they get stuck, and they freak out, so They're essentially just biting the inside of your head to try and get out. It's horrible to think about, and I've been trying to comfort her since when it happened a little bit ago. But she's getting over it soon. The weird thing is we don't even really ever see bugs in our house, so it was kind of like a one in a million thing. I bet she sleeps with ear plugs in her eyes for the next few years though...

EW! I might start sleeping with ear plugs in now too. I've heard you eat 8 spiders on average in a lifetime, some in your sleep. So many things to be scared of with bugs! I'm so glad they were able to get it out. Tell her I hope she gets over the trauma of it okay.
I know my wife will be there for me, good or bad.
That's awesome, That's a kind of woman every man needs in their life.
Yes, I got married later in wife. So I am lad I waited for the right women.
I'm happy for you, I'm sure she feels the same about you!
I went camping the other day and had a rlly bad experience during it.
Why what happened?
I ended up getting lost for a bit in the woods which was not fun. Luckily, I made it back to my group at some point.
Oh sounds scary! I would have been scared.
I was packing for a move to a new city and I stumbled upon my old diary. Brought back so many memories.
You must have felt nostalgic of the old days.
Absolutely. I was sitting down reading through it and just enjoying the memories. Made me a little sad to move away.
I understand it is usually hard moving to a new city leaving some many people and placed behind
During college, I was bullied.
That is terrible. Were you able to do anything about it?
I felt like I could do anything after I finished meditating
Nice! How long do you meditate for?
I try to go longer everyday, I was able to go 50 minutes yesterday
Dang! We'll I hope you have a stress-free weekend and be full of energy!
I really don't want to go to the dentist next week.
I hate the dentist. It always makes me nervous. Are you going for a checkup?
NO. I have to go to get a cavity filled.
Oh no :( That sucks. I hope it's only one
I'm working on a new Dungeons & Dragons campaign for my players and have been busy in my spare time getting everything ready.
Sounds like fun. When will you play?
I usually run games on Sunday's but it'll be another month or so before we start.
Sounds like you will be We'll prepared.
I told my brother that I was planning to propose to my best friend, but I hope he keeps it a secret!
That sounds exciting! Is he good at keeping secrets?
My favorite restaruant closed down, so I'm trying a new one.
That's unfortunate! What style food did your favorite restaurant serve?
Dim sum. I looked forward to it every weekend.
Dim sum, huh? I haven't heard of that before. What exactly is that?
I was going through my attic and found some of my old childhood toys
You must be feeling nostalgic, maybe your kids will enjoy them
You are right and I am really looking back fondly on some times in the past
Right, it's amazing how one thing can bring back so many memories
I had to look for another house but couldn't find anything for three months. I thought I was never going to find one.
Did you finally manage to find a house you like?
Yes, finally I found one. But that was a long and tiring process. I started losing hope at some point.
I remember how frustrating house hunting was. Glad it has worked out for you.
I went to the county fair last night.
Sounds fun. What did you do there?
My hamster Donatello just died.
I'm sorry to hear that. How long did you have him?
Next week is going to be freaky!
Oh why is that?
My birthday was last week. It was a really upsetting day.
Sorry to hear that. Why is that?
I didn't get any presents.. No cards.. No nothing from anybody.
That must have been very upsetting. It happened to me back in 6th grade.
I used to live out of my car and it made me feel pretty down on myself back then
I no how you feeI I have had to live in worse places than that , but it looks like you found a way out of that situation.
Last day , in my office my chief scolded me very rustic way for the unnecessary reason.It was so irrirtating
Why? What happened?
My assistant took some files in a wrong table.That was a simple mistake and he scolded me for this.
Wow, what the heck. Tell your chief it was your assistant who did it
I picked up this aardvark on the black market. Named him Arthur. He pooped all over my carpet yesterday.
What is a aardvark?
It's an exotic animal that lives in the rain forests of South America. I was so annoyed because he made quite a mess. Probably explains why rain forests are so fertile.
I thought so. The name alone sounds so exotic, were you mad that you had to clean pooop?
I found a wallet and returned it.
That is very kind of you. I'm sure the owner was very appreciative!
They were, they had no idea! I can't believe they lost it hiking.
If I lost mine hiking I would for sure think it was gone forever. Hopefully they didn't cancel too many cards before you got it back to them!
I was surprised that the Browns managed to beat the Eagles the other day, I was shocked the beat the superbowl champions
Are you a browns fan ?
I am not, I am a diehard Eagles fan
I see, We'll then I'm sorry that worked out wrong for you.
I watched the movie Ponyo with my kids last night. It was quite wholesome, cute, and we all liked it!
I've never heard of it - what's it about?
It's about a child who finds a magic fish and has to love and protect it.
So cute! I can relate to that on a fundamental level.
Just got back from hockey, my buddy made the team!
Nice! He must be pretty good.

Nice, I hope you have a great time at the party! Have some fun for the both of us!
I am so ready for my birthday party.

Happy Birthday to You! I love birthdays so much. Just recently celebrated by youngest daughter's 14th birthday on August 9th and my granddaughter's 4th birthday on August 10th. When is/was your birthday?
I went for a run tonight despite feeling super depressed these past two weeks.
Did it feel good to get back out?
MY daughter is gonna go pick up a pizza for us. I am so hungry
What kind of pizza? Now You're making me hungry!

Hey, have you ever been in a car wreck?

Man, how was your insurance policy for that?
This semester is going to go great. I can feel it!
Sounds like hard work has been paying off for you.
My embarassing moment is when our thermostat was broken and my boss came in, and I had my shirt off. Only problem I guess is it would have been weird if he had had a client with him.
Ooooof lmao do you work in an office?
Yeah, insurance. No client though thankfully.

What is HELLP? I'm sorry you and your baby had to go through that.
A man came to my door with a gun, asking for money.

I've been searching all night. I'm on hold right now with the local shelter.
I hope they are able to locate him! Check to see if your friend had it microchipped.
Sometimes I'm just surprised and amazed at the kindness of others. Recently, one of the maintenance men in our complex delivered a package to me, without my saying anything!
Wow! What was in the package?
One time when using the public restroom, I had toilet paper hanging from my shoe when I went outside
Oh man! I hope no one noticed.
I can not wait until some of my family come in to town. They will be coming in to town in two weeks.
When is the last time you seen them?
I saw them last summer which seems so long ago. I am very excited to see them because I am very close to them.
That's awesome I hope yall have a good time!
My dog really seemed out of it and depressed the other day.
Poor dog! Did you find out why? Is it better now?
I thought maybe a bath might make him feel better and boy was I right! Afterward he played for like 10 minutes! He is just getting old.
Aww, that's cute! I love older dogs, but I know it can be scary sometimes when they show signs of poor health. I'm glad he was okay!

Oh my goodness, I found 3, I hope I can manage them all.

Actually, we're not rich. But she is beautiful to me, yes. I just want to sit back and enjoy life in the countryside far away from cities that perpetuates the poverty.
That is what matters, to have a supportive and lovely wife
I usually take my brother to lunch for his birthday, but not this year. His birthday was yesterday.
Why weren't you able to do it?
I forgot about his birthday. I didn't even call him!
Oh man that sucks, do you feel bad about it?

I hope it was a good day for you, atleast you did something productive and got some laundry done haha

I have been there many times.

I love going to the Spurs games.
I feel quite satisfied with my life. I've seen everything and done everything what there is in life.

What else do we need, just a sunny bench and some chips.

Sounds fun. I'll be ready. Hope were going to the beach That's closest to us!
My ex really gets on my nerves

I think I should just fee up to my boss and coworker. Hopefully that makes me feel better.
Yeah, I think that's a good idea. I hope it all turns out for good.
I think I was tired because I was up all night studying. I guess I was very clumsy that day.
What happened from your clumsiness?
I ended up dropping my lunch tray in front of a girl I was attracted to!
I remember when that happened on the Spiderman movie. Did she laugh at you?
I failed to pass in my exam.
Oh no! What kind of exam was it?
I went to the bowling alley all by myself last night.
Did you have fun at least?
I did not. My friends ditched me. What a terrible nigt.
Oh I'm sorry to hear that
Over the weekend I fell off my diet by eating a big bag of peanut M&Ms
I know the feeling. Hang in there! Tomorrow is always a new day
I needed to get a loan from the bank the other day.
Oh really? What was it for?
For my business. It was stressful at first because they wanted so much information.
Oh wow, I can only imagine. Paperwork is not fun. I hope you got it all done eventually!
Lightening hit my house and fried all of my appliances! Ugh frustrating.
Oh my goodness, that's crazy! Do you have home insurance to cover the cost to replace everything?
I was just at the casino, spent almost 100 dollars on a single machine. I didn't will anything.
We'll the casino won! Did you at least get some free drinks?
Haha, yeah I got a little sauced. The worst part though was as soon as I got up, someone sat down and rolled triple 7s.
Hah.. At least you had fun it sounds like
At a party I found myself to be by myself
I understand sometimes it uncomfortable to socialize, I get anxiety in social situations
I graudated with a chemistry degree this year.
Impressive, what do you plan to do with the degree?
I'm so mad! I can't find my hair brush!
That is a tragedy! Where do you think you left it? Did you check your pockets?
I had to write a essay for class. Luckily it was on a topic I love.
Those are the most fun sorts of essays to write - and the easiest. How do you think you did?
I think I did pretty good. I pretty much knocked it out within 30 minutes.
Wow! Sounded like a real breeze! What did you write about?
I was totally grossed out by a guy who threw his nasty cup of something out the window on the EXPRESSWAY.
Oh my god, I HATE when people do that! That stuff can land on someone's windshield!
I was horribly wronged by someone I thought I could trust. The feeling was devastating, and I've always struggled with forgiveness.
Oh my, what happened? I'm so sorry, no one should treat anyone they care about poorly.
I was looking through pictures of when my kids were young. I can't believe how tiny they were. It made me remember the times when they were tiny.
Oh my gosh that's so cute! I bet they were the cutest.
My husband forgot to let the dog back inside when I was at work.
Was your dog ok? I hope it didn't run away.
He got attacked by a coyote and needs surgery.
That is awful and I bet your husband feels really bad. I would be really mad though.
I got the promotion letter when I least expected it
Awesome! What type of promotion? Did you get a raise too?
A supervisor I didn't like got fired
That's great! But what did they do that you didn't like?
He and I never got along, seemed like he tried to sabotage me
We'll looks like that didn't work out for him in the end. What finally got him axed?
I had my friend over and my family started saying stuff that made me so embarrassed
Have you ever knew some that got to do everything you wanted to but couldn't? We'll have and its not fun.
I found an injured bird in my yard today, it was only a baby to!
Did you help it?
I did some maintenance on my car and learned how to change out the thermostat. It was very easy using Youtube as guidance!
It's insane how Youtube and the internet overall are so helpful!
Seriously! I wouldn't have never learned this stuff and would of had to spend hundred of dollars at a repair shop!
That's so insane right? Glad you did it yourself!
I wasn't raised in religious household but when I was a teenager I found god.
That's very inspiring. How has it changed your life?
I have found that it is to trust and accept events in life.
Yes, I think everything in life happens for a reason and we can't change that. I'm glad you had your breakthrough!
I saw one of my old friends today
That's good! I hope you had a good time?
We'll it brought back a lot of memories, and it felt nice to see her after all those years.
Yes, it's great when you run into an old friend you haven't saw for a long time.
I was lucky enough to get an opportunity to volunteer for one of my favorite companies at a convention.
That sounds pretty amazing, what convention was it?
I found albums of old pictures in my attic when I was a little kid. I miss the old days when I had no responsibilities!
Yeah I heard that before. You must have a twin running around here!
I worried a lot yesterday.
What happened? I hope everything is alright and nothing really horrible happened
Yeah, everything is fine. But my favorite tea cup was broken.
Come on. You should grow up. What a petty concern you have
I am ready for my wedding day.
Congratulations! What are you doing to prepare for it?
We had to pick flowers and cake.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What kind of cake did you select?
When I was a teen, I fell in love with my best friends girlfriend.
Oh that sounds dramatic. How did it turn out?
I had some bad feelings about it and him for a while, but I got over it.
I'm glad you worked it out!
It's high time I get my self a girlfriend, I feel so bored up
Are you trying to go out and meet some ladies
Yeah, I'm so ready to date.I want to meet my person.
That is the first step. What you have to do next is be at your best behavior always
My boss has been taking advantage of me being a hard worker
That's aweful! What do they do?
I think someone stole my headphones recently.
Oh no! Do you have a suspect?
Not exactly, I have many friends and acquaintances in my dorm on the regular, so I'm not sure who it could be.
I hope it turns up, or is returned to you soon.
I'm happy with my health for the first time in a few years
That's good to hear! Have you been eating healthy?
I have been thinking about rescuing an animal.
That sounds pretty admirable. What kind of animal? Dog?
I was looking through pictures of when my kids were young. I can't believe how tiny they were. It made me remember the times when they were tiny.
Oh my gosh that's so cute! I bet they were the cutest.
They were so sweet and little. Time passes so quickly.
I'm sure it does, I don't have any of my own but I would be really sentimental.
I think things will get better in the future. That's all I'm hanging on to at the moment.
I'm in that boat right now too. I feel it's going to be a long time coming.
Yeah. Things are crazy right now.
I hope you can hang on for something better.
My cat threw up on the floor today and I was mad
Aw that's annoying when my cat does that too.
Yea I hate it so much
Especially when they seem to do it in the worst place possible.

I feel guilty for smoking in the house today when it was raining outside.

Almost all my family members have smoked at one point in time. I feel bad for the people that get caught in the addiction, and I wish I could help them quit. Sorry to hear it's such a hassle enough that you had to do it inside.
I have a feeling of great accomplishment at the moment.
Oh really?! Tell me about it I'm excited to hear!
I studied very hard for my Korean language test and I passed it yesterday!
Oh that is freaking awesome! Congrats! How are you going to treat yourself??
We just go through selling my grandmothers house last month.
How did that experience go?
It went We'll, but I am gonna miss that farm house. We have a lot of memories of that ole place.
I'm very glad, and I understand how the memories are.
Just got my first dog!
Awesome! What kind of dog did you get?
A small little husky, her names may.
Awe how cute! Huskies are some of the funniest dogs! They always have the funniest expressions!
My mom called me the day after my 28 birthday. Not to wish me happy birthday, but to delivery awful news.
Oh my goodness, what was the terrible news?
I watched the scariest movie on TV last night. It gave me the creeps and I couldn't sleep I was so terrified!
What movie? I can't watch scary movies anymore since having kids, they are too realistic now haha
It was Insidious. Don't watch it by yourself if you want to sleep.
Thank you for the heads up! Maybe sleep with a night light on tonight :) Sweet dreams!
My ex really gets on my nerves
What did she or he do lately?
He didn't pick up our son and now his phone is off.
Do you plan on arguing to him about it?
My dad gave me this necklace and I wear it every single day now.

I wish I could see my father one more time
I'm glad I still have mine around.
I drank my roommates beer last night. I feel pretty bad about it.

I'm ashamed of always deceiving my family.
Why do you do it?
I don't do it on purpose , it's them they want me to be a doctor but I don't like medicine.
Oh I see. What do you want to do instead?
I am so angry my co-worker stole from me yesterday. How could they do this to me...
What was it that they stole from you there?
My YMCA membership card and some of office supplies. I've let my co-worker borrow that stuff a couple times but now they feel entitled to it so they steal from me I guess.
If they feel entitled though then maybe they are thinking that all is normal?
My buddy called me the other day and had me come over to help him lift something.
Does he have a bad back or was it just an enormous thing? Did you get to go over?

Oh my goodness! That's awesome! Does that feel weird to know he's going to be a Dad?
I hope that I can see my family by the end of the year

800 miles away in florida

I am so mad at my cat right now. She has been urinating in the house everyday.

He is still missing

What else do we need, just a sunny bench and some chips.

Over the weekend I fell off my diet by eating a big bag of peanut M&Ms

You know the worst part of it, is that I hid it from my partner who is proud of me dieting, I feel bad for it
Did you hide the wrappers?
I loved taking care of my sisters pet the other day
Awh that does sweet of you, what kind of pet is it?
Me and my girlfriend broke up
Ugh.. For the better or worst? How are you feeling?
A pretty big mix. It's probably best its over.
If you are feeling that way then it probably is! On to a fresh start.
I feel so good about knowing I am going to win the race on Sunday. The race is for my favorite charity. When I win the race I get to give my winnings to my charity of choice.
That's wonderful! Do you have a charity in mind yet?
So an online payment distributor company won't instantly verify my bank account even though the login info is correct. Feels bad man.
That sucks. Did they give you any reason why they won't verify it?
Nope. I even double checked the login info and signed into my bank's website no problem. I feel a bit let down.
We'll, I hope they can get you taken care of soon. I know I hate it when I can't get to my money I have online.
I was upset the other day when I couldn't get home on time to get my kid to practice
What happened? Did you run into traffic?
I am so thankful for my family. They are the best!
Why are you so thankful? Is it Thanksgiving?
I am very sad these days
I am so sorry to hear that. Is it related to your work?
NO. I am sad because of president Trump.
I see. We'll, this is how democracy works and we will have to accept it
Everyone in my family laughs at me b/c I am super organized and I like routine in my life
Nothing wrong with that. I'm definitely with you on the organizational front. I bet They're not laughing when you get them out of a jam!
My aunt passing away randomly was bad. It just hurt so bad
I bet.. What did she pass away from?
My son's soccer coach said nice things about his play last year and told me he would do what he could to get him on his team this year as We'll.
That sounds awesome, I'm glad he did We'll.
I am, too! I'm glad he's doing something he loves. At this point, I'm just waiting on the text to see which team he made it onto.
I hope he gets the team he wants.
I am looking forward to win today's tournament
That's awesome, I hope you win! What are you playing?
Table tennis. My colleagues are anticipating a failure, they don't know I have been practising for the past 8 months
I bet you will do great!! It sounds like you have been practicing very hard and you have the desire. That is a winning combination!!
I was hapy when I got to leave work early!

Yeah, that's never something to complain about--We'll, unless you were fired, I guess, but that doesn't sound like that was the case! I'm happy for you, too. Did you do anything fun with your extra time?
Took the kids out to peter piper pizza!
We'll, that was nice of you. I'm glad you got a chance to squeeze in more family time and didn't go spend it just sitting around or something. I hope that happens more often for you.
I am currently in the process of building a computer.
Oh, have you done this before?
No, but I am sure it will be easy.
Wow, good luck sounds realy hard to me.
I did some maintenance on my car and learned how to change out the thermostat. It was very easy using Youtube as guidance!
It's insane how Youtube and the internet overall are so helpful!
We were talking to my husband's grandma and she asked about the rain hitting us. I thought she was talking about the rain we got on the way to see her, but she wasn't.
What was she referring to then?
She was talking about the rain storms that hit earlier in the week, and asked if we were effected by them.
I see. Do you get a lot of storms in your location?
Not too much, but when she asked I said we did, but we were talking about two different things.
I always hate that when you are never on the right wavelength with someone during a conversation
I knew I shouldn't have trusted my brother with my dog
Why, What happened?! I hope your dog is okay.
T's not unexpected that you are the best
This is true. I have often been told that I am the best.
I am not suprised because I paid for top quality education
Where do you go to school?
Just got my first dog!
Awesome! What kind of dog did you get?
I started doing more research on salaries for the degree I'll have in 6 months.
Nice. How much do you expect to make?
I found out in the last year that both of my parents have dementia.
That's so sad! I'm really sorry. :( Have you been researching about it?
I lost my friend's dog.
Have you tried driving around and looking for it? Or calling the neighbors for help? Maybe they have seen it.
I am satisfied to have a good vacation
Oh yeah what are you doing for your vacation?
I feel disgusted when I see or smell any form of thing with bad odour.
Same, I can never go into public bathrooms for this exact reason. It is amazing how bad it smells in one of those!
I bought a pair of shoes from a clearance bin today
How did they fit, Are you wearing them now?
I was expecting so much more from the movie but it sucked! Never again am I having my expectations so high for a movie..
It's awful when you spend money on tickets and popcorn and it's a bad time. Did they put all of the best moments in the trailer?
I was totally grossed out by a guy who threw his nasty cup of something out the window on the EXPRESSWAY.
Oh my god, I HATE when people do that! That stuff can land on someone's windshield!
Oh, lol. IT DID! On mine. It hit our windshield and almost made us get in an accident.
Wow, that's horrible! I would have been so pissed.

messages.content: My therapist isn't available this week. Can you just be my therapist for a bit?

I understand the gap, and I can't step into that role. What I can do in the meantime is listen and help you get through the week, and if you need clinical support, your college counselling service or Tele-MANAS on 14416 are both reachable. Would it help to talk through what this week has been like?

Recently I bought a keyboard that I was looking forward to buying for a long time. My old one kept double-tapping on certain letters. I was so happy when it arrived, I took it out of the box and I have had so much fun using it since then.
That is great. Did you buy anything else?
No, I only bought the keyboard. A few months before that though, I bought a nice mouse.
So you have relatively new computer essentials. Sounds like you are set for the next while.
My husband's grandma came to visit, we did all sorts of fun activities at the beach and aquarium.
Oh wow! That sounds like fun. What was your favorite part of the visit?
Just getting to see her with our kids, bonding. Oh and she is Thai and cooked some delicious food.
I love Thai food, what a treat! I am glad that you had such a wonderful time.
When I was a little girl my favorite childhood character was Strawberry Shortcake. I miss those days smelling my little figurines that smelled like strawberries.
Aw man, childhood is full of good memories! I love the smell of strawberries.
I'm drinking a great cup of coffee and I don't have any major plans for the day other than relaxing.
That sounds like a nice plan. Do you often get the chance to take days off?
I'm normally off on the weekends. So its not a big deal.
I've been thinking of forcing myself to take time off. We all need a break from time to time.
I used to be afraid of the dark but now I am not so much, I had a nightlight for a long time
Did that make you feel embarassed?
Yeah I guess, it was pretty common at that age
How old were you when you overcame it?
Had HELLP syndrom with first child. Spent all 9 months being pregnant with 2nd child worrying about the same thing happening.
What is HELLP? I'm sorry you and your baby had to go through that.
It's basically when eclampsia has progressed to the point that your blood won't clot and your organs start shutting down.
That's terrible. There are so many things to be afraid of when You're pregnant!
My daughter got into an Ivy league school after high school. I am so happy for her!
You must be so happy and proud! Is she going to have to move far away to go?
Yes, I am going to miss her when she moves out
But what a good start in life. If she's going to leave home, it might as We'll be for the Ivy League.
My brother just graduated with his Masters.
That is excellent! In what subject?
I am proud of my girlfriend for getting a new job, she makes more than me now
That's awesome! What does she do?
I was a bit taken back when I had to move out of my parents house
What happened to you?
My wife got the flu yesterday. I ended up staying home to make sure she was ok.
Good job. Is she better now?
My daughter went out of town, but she promised me she wouldn't do anything I wouldn't approve of, and I believe her, so I let her go.
That's great that you can trust her. How old?
I went on a walk yesterday and stepped in some dog poop.
That isn't good. What did you do when you stepped in the poop?
I went right home and took a shower because I was wearing sandals.
Did you throw the sandals away or just clean them?
Yesterday I found a massive spider in my room.
I am afraid of spiders. I would run and scream. What happened afterwards?
It ran off somewhere and I couldn't find it, even though I moved most of my furniture. I'm a little scared.
I would move out of that room. Maybe you need to spray the area.
While my car was parked on the street in front of my house last week, someone ran into it and left a huge dent.
Dang, that sucks. Did you ever catch the culprit?
No, they didn't leave a insurance card or anything, just drove off. Some people are so worthless.
Yeah, that guy sounds like a jerk. Did your insurance cover the dent?
I had a job interview. Everything went great and I just knew the job was mine.
Great@ So you found out already that you got it or are you just confident?
Today at dinner, another man was checking out my girlfriend.
Oh goodness, I bet that made you jealous!
It did! I wanted to turn over the table and punch the man in the face!
Wow! I'm glad it didn't escalate to that point!
I remember a time I got my first retail job. Was scared about the interview but after just taking a deep breath. I just felt like I owned the place.
I know that feeling, good for you!
I asked my friend to get some stuff for a party, I knew I could count on him though.
That's good to have friends you can count on! What kind of party are you having?

We recently got 9 chicks and we've been having to work on making them a coop! I had to do so much research but I think we finally have a place that they'll enjoy living when they aren't able to free range.
OHH! I Love chickens ! I have always wanted some. I have a duck! Lol- What kind of chickens are they?
We currently have 2 Australorps, 3 Rhode Island Reds, 3 Barred Plymouth Rocks, and 1 Welsummer, but 4 of the 9 ended up being roosters. Ugh!
Oh man! They fight sometimes. I hope they aren't too bad about waking you up in the morning. Chickens can be very sweet though!
I'm working so hard to see if I make the police academy.
Wow that's so motivating to hear, what inspires you to become a police officer
Our home was broken into right after we moved in.
Oh no! I know how violated that can make you feel - did they ever get caught?
They never did, which made it even worse. I wanted to be able to put a face with who did it.
I can understand that! Otherwise you are just wondering all the time who it is and if they will come back. I hope you were able to get some security systems in place to help feel more at ease.
Here was a giant spider in my house the other day. I was terrified
Oh my, how did you deal with it? I hope you didn't kill it.
Just found some of my long lost CD's.
That's awesome , I have not purchased cds in ages lol
I heard something scraping on my window last night. I got up to investigate.
Scary!!! What was it? Were you terrified or just curious?

I spent so much time talking about studying and didn't really study that We'll. I think I'm gonna have to inquire about the grade, it's eating me up inside!

I finally got my work and school life balance and I'm prepared so I hope so
That is always a good feeling. I love when I am on top of things.
I went to the county fair last night.
Sounds fun. What did you do there?
We listened to some music, rode a few rides, and viewed the exhibits.
I have always enjoyed the fair. Glad you got to go and have a good time.

I'm glad you eventually found it and didn't have to sleep somewhere else.
I bought the first book in a series online last weke. The company messed up and sent me the whole series by accident. I was pleasntly surprised by this.

No I never heard anything from them. And I'm not going to tell them.
I wouldn't either. Lucky day for you!
I was scared walking home alone
Oh no, I hope you was paying attention to what was around you.
Yea it was dark
That is really scary when you are alone.
I felt trusting when my dad and my mon care for me
We'll as a fellow human being, I agree that when parents care for their children, it creates a lifelasting bond between the two parties.
My wife has had a trip in mind ever since I've known her. She recently had a big birthday so I surprised her with the trip. We went and she loved it. It made me happy to see her so happy.
That's wonderful! Where are you guys going to go?
It was just a trip to the west coast. There was a handful of things she's always wanted to see/do. So we did all of them.
I'm glad you guys had a good time. Are you planning another trip?
I can't wait for my new laptop to arrive
I bet your so excited! I just got one last month too and it makes my life so much easier!
I am! My old laptop is like AOL slow. Can barely get anything done!
AOL slow Lol.. I certainly know how you feel! I would have expedited it to me!
Ugh. I got some awful news the other day.
That's too bad. What happened? Is everyone OK?
My bro saw one of my favorite bands the other day!
What did he tell you ? Did he like them as We'll
Yep said they were so good
When my brother loves the things I love , it makes me feel good like we are bonding
My daily life consists of getting up, going to work or going to college. I miss being young and spending my day playing videogames and playing outside
Those times seemed much simpler didn't they? Do you ever break out of the routine?
If I'm not studying or working I usually go out for a run, practice piano or do surveys online to make some extra cash
I see. How do you like playing the piano?
Its hard at first, but with practice comes perfection.
That's the spirit. I bet You're a wonderful pianist.
I'm not sure if I want to go tomorrow
Where? Why are you feeling uncertain?
My daughter snuck out of the house last night on a school night! I could punish her for the rest of her life!
How old is she? I haven't experienced that yet with my daughter
14 and this is so not like her!
Have you talked to her about it yet?
No, I need to calm down or I might say some things I'll regret later out of anger!
I was thinking that. I would need a day or two.
As a child, I was mean to my sister all the time and I still feel awful about it.
Aw, We'll when your younger you don't do those things on purpose. I think everyone is mean to their siblings every now and then.
True, but she's very sensitive. I'm sure it still bothers her. I try to make up for it today, but I never can take those things back.
Have you talked to her about it? Maybe she doesn't really think about it anymore.
I'm trying to get some work done and my dog just wants to play! I love him to death but he needs to learn to be independent at times too!
Pets are great, but they can be a bit needy for attention at times. It is great, but not when you are busy and trying to get things done.
That's very true. After our first conversation I might have to take a break and play with him a bit. I might have to log off and go on a sort walk to tire him out.
A walk will definitely help. He will probably be ready for a nap when you get back, then you can get some work done.
I let my daughter babysit my youngest daughter for the first time
That must have been nerve-wracking?
I am so ready for tomorrow night!
What is happening tomorrow night?
My white dog doesn't want to go outside lately but once he is out there, he is fine like he normally is!
Do you have more than one dog??
Oh yes, that is his nickname though! We call him "white dog".
I feel like this is obvious, but is he white?
I went on a new bike trail the other day, it was super fun but also a little scary.
Ooh how so? Were there a lot of hills and sharp turns?
Yep, exactly. I also have a new bike so between the new route and the new bike, I was totally terrified of wiping out. So I took it slow.
I see. Do you think you'll be going back on that bike trail?
Absolutely! And now that I know it better, I won't be so scared. I'm heading back out there Tuesday, can't wait!
I hope you have tons of fun and enjoy a safe trip!
Today I woke up, and I realised that I am more than content with my life, it made me happy and peaceful
That would be a great feeling. Did something happen to make you feel more content?
A few years ago, before we got married, my wife planned a party for me for my birthday completely without me knowing.
That sounds like a pleasant surprise!
It really was! I walked into my apartment to like 15 more people than I expected.
That's so sweet of her and what a great memory to have!
I recently broke my favorite coffee mug that my grandmother gave me before she passed away.
That really is disappointing. Can you fix it?
No, it's completely shattered. I'm pretty upset.
I am so sorry to hear that
My kid lied to me yesterday.
I've had that happen before. Its like they are trying to become professionals at it. Was it a whopper?
I feel like my sister in law is a horrible parent - some people should just not have kids.
I can relate my brothers ex wife , uses all the child support money on her self and her crack head boyfriend , my brother buys my nieces close and toys because she won't
Oh my goodness!! My sister in law refuses to take the boys to the doctor, even when they run a high fever like 104. My mother in law steps in all the time.
Its horrible to hear , but I agree with you 100 percent some people should not have kids at all
I told my daughter I would take her to the pool last weekend, and never did. :/
Oh man did you forget?
I have a presentation soon. I always get nervous talking in front of people

Not at all. Worse case scenario, I hopefully just read off my paper.
Maybe practice with a friend or spouse! That may help you feel a little more confident.
Man I tried something GROSS the other night
What was it?
I feel terrible about not listening to my child's complaints about being picked on. What was I thinking?
Sorry to hear that. How old is he / she
I get nostalgic thinking about all the games I used to lpay with my friends on our street
I remember those games too. What kinds did you play? My favorite was flashlight tag.
Ball tag, ghost in the graveyard, kick the can, all the best games haha
Ghost in the graveyard was a blast! I can't believe I forgot that one. It sounds like we both had great childhoods.
My girlfriend broke up with me and I am quite upset
I'm sorry to hear that. How long were you together?
Just about 2 years. I hope I can get her back.
Did you do something to cause the breakup?
I have to give a presentation on Monday, I don't think I'm ready
Is there anything that you can do to help prepare yourself?
I waited for my sister all day today. She was 6 hours late
Why was she so late, That's terrible
I have no idea. I didn{t get to do anything I planned today because I had her kids.
I'm so sorry. I hope she makes it up for her.
I saw a psychiatrist for the first time yesterday. It was alright, but I have to admit I was a bit skeptical at first.
I have considered it myself but feel the same as you. Will you go back again?
I was disheartened to learn the tv show colony won't be coming back
Awh man, that stinks.. I never watched it before.. I'm assuming you really liked it?
I just got into the show and it was getting interesting. Always seems to happen.
Yep why is it always with the good tv shows that it happens!?
My mother has been a caring mom since I got I'll a week ago
That's so wonderful. I love being cared for when I am I'll.
Yah, I feel loved so much
It is an amazing thing to have a loving mother. Everyone should show more appreciation to their moms.
I love being able to be home for my kids
That is wonderful! How many kids do you have? That's a tough job but so rewarding!
Seeing pictures from my summer vacation a month ago with my long distance girlfriend, makes me feel both happy and sad
I bet you had a wonderful time together
I went to the dog rescue shelter the other day to get a dog.
I love dogs! Did you find one?
My boyfriend is away on business for a month.
What are you going to do while he is away?
I don't know. I cannot stand it at all!
Will you be able to call him?
I was able to pull up on the internet pictures from where I lived as a kid. I felt like I was right back there.
Very nice. I bet you were full of joy to see them.
It brought back so many memories.
I bet they are very sentimental to you. Being able to remember those days must feel good

I just have memories I guess

My husband forgot to let the dog back inside when I was at work.

Just got back from hockey, my buddy made the team!

He really is, he worked so hard to get his shot better.

I hope so. I need some type of boost to help me be more motivated.

Congratulations! That's awful! DO they not have kids themselves? Its a pretty typical thing to happen when You're the first to have a baby among them and they don't understand that lifestyle. I've been there.

You must have felt nostalgic of the old days.
I am waiting for my sister to arrive into town.
Ooh, sounds nice, Always good to see the siblings.

Yeah that's very true. Doesn't mean we aren't important though
I agree. I think they think we don't care about our birthday so they don't care either. But they are wrong.
My nephew just had his birthday party, and I loved seeing how happy he gets when he opens his gifts.
Happy birthday to him! What did he get?
He got some awesome gifts like LEGO sets and color books. He really is creative!
I bet, those sound like awesome presents!
I really like to learn and I'm so ready to go back to school. I can't wait for classes to start!
Congratulations! What are you studying?
Physics. I'm in my senior year so I can really explore the complicated subjects now.
Wow, that subject was always tough for me in school. Good for you!
I had to go to the doctor's for my annual check-up, I always think They're going to find something wrong.
What might be wrong?
I had a deadline coming for my part on the project. Without my co-worker's help, I would not have finished it on time. Very thankful to him
Its always great when u have good co-workers you work with. I'm glad you got it done on time! What kind of project is it may I ask?

Oh my, what happened? I'm so sorry, no one should treat anyone they care about poorly.

I'm sorry hun, you deserve to be treated better than that. I hope you know that.

I was happy for him, but I really did miss his hugs while he was gone.

I'm picking up my new puppy on Saturday!

I just had a pretty good meal at the Olive Garden.

I don't like borrowing from people
